notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
MARCH 10
Patch 1.0.1

Bug fixes:
To avoid the problem of not saving and crash the game was done changing the save directory to the default RPG Maker instead of the default windows directory (in case you lose your save data go to the directory "C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Roaming\Destiny of Light" and copy the contents to the "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Destiny of Light\www\save" directory)
